description: V0.12.2 curated naming batch 4 (26 new entries on top of batch 1+2+3's 60). Pattern-based detection of state setters/getters and zero-init helpers.

names.name: global_state_set_d
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; str r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: State setter D (4th global state slot). 3 callers.

names.name: arm7_global_state_set_a
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; str r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: ARM7 first global state setter. 9 callers.

names.name: global_dword_get_d
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: 1-level ptr deref global dword (4th variant). 3 callers.

names.name: global_dword_get_e
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: 1-level ptr deref global dword (5th variant). 4 callers.

names.name: global_dword_get_f
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: 1-level ptr deref global dword (6th variant). 6 callers.

names.name: global_dword_get_g
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: 1-level ptr deref global dword (7th variant). 4 callers.

names.name: global_dword_get_h
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: 1-level ptr deref global dword (8th variant). 4 callers.

names.name: global_dword_get_i
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldr r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: 1-level ptr deref global dword (9th variant). 6 callers.

names.name: global_halfword_set_b
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; strh r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: Global halfword setter (2nd variant). 5 callers.

names.name: global_halfword_set_c
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; strh r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: Global halfword setter (3rd variant). 6 callers.

names.name: global_byte_set_a
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #4]; strb r0, [r1]; bx lr
names.note: Global byte setter. 4 callers.

names.name: global_halfword_get_a
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldrh r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Global halfword getter. 5 callers.

names.name: global_halfword_get_b
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #4]; ldrh r0, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Global halfword getter (2nd variant). 5 callers.

names.name: dcache_clean_range_v2
names.disasm: bic r0, r0, #0x1f; mcr p15, ...; ... loop
names.note: D-cache clean range (2nd variant). 5 callers.

names.name: dcache_clean_invalidate_v2
names.note: D-cache clean+invalidate (2nd variant). 3 callers.

names.name: struct_zero_init_2field
names.disasm: mov r1, #0; str r1, [r0]; str r1, [r0, #4]; bx lr
names.note: Zero two consecutive word fields. 6 callers.

names.name: struct_clear_3field
names.disasm: mov r2, #0; str r2, [r0]; str r2, [r0, #4]; strh r2, [r0, #8]; bx lr
names.note: Zero 2 words + 1 halfword. 2 callers.

names.name: dual_global_clear
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #0x10]; mov r2, #0; ldr r0, [pc, #0xc]; str r2, [r1]; str r2, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Clear two globals to 0. 1 caller.

names.name: struct_field_18_to_24_with_clear
names.disasm: ldr r1, [r0, #0x18]; add r2, r0, #0x24; str r1, [r0, #0x24]; mov r0, #0; str r0, [r2, #8]; bx lr
names.note: Copies offset 0x18 to offset 0x24, then clears 0x2c. 1 caller.

names.name: cache_invalidate_struct_2field
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #0x10]; mov r2, #0; ldr r1, [r0, #8]; str r2, [r0]; str r1, [r0, #4]; bx lr
names.note: Saves offset+8 to offset+4 then clears offset+0. 3 callers - cache invalidation pattern.

names.name: struct_field_clear
names.disasm: mov r1, #0; str r1, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Single field clear to 0. 2 callers.

names.name: global_array_set_0x24_stride
names.disasm: mov r2, #0x24; mul r2, r0, r2; ldr r0, [pc, #4]; str r1, [r0, r2]; bx lr
names.note: Stores r1 to global[r0 * 0x24] (36-byte stride array). 1 caller.

names.name: dual_global_clear_v2
names.disasm: ldr r1, [pc, #0x10]; mov r2, #0; ldr r0, [pc, #0xc]; str r2, [r1]; str r2, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Clear two globals to 0 (2nd variant). 1 caller.

names.name: struct_clear_2field
names.disasm: ldr r0, [pc, #0xc]; mov r1, #0; str r1, [r0, #4]; str r1, [r0]; bx lr
names.note: Clear obj+0 and obj+4 to 0 (reverse order). 1 caller.

names.name: struct_field_0xb4_set
names.disasm: str r1, [r0, #0xb4]; bx lr
names.note: Writes r1 to struct field 0xb4. 1 caller.

names.name: switch_dispatch_3way_alt
names.disasm: cmp r2, #0; beq ...; cmp r2, #1; beq ...; cmp r2, #2; beq ...
names.note: Switch dispatch on r2 in {0, 1, 2, ...}. 3 callers.
